paragrafi: The guided animation framework lets animators describe motion with text, draw spline paths and set target poses, with the model generating motion that follows those constraints.
Other updates include RTX Dynamic Illumination 3.2 with stratified low‑discrepancy sampling and RTX Path Tracing 1.9 performance optimizations.
Gaijin Entertainment also shared its integration of DLSS 5 with 3D‑Guided Neural Rendering in War Thunder, adapting its color pipeline to evaluate DLSS 5 in sRGB before mapping back to linear HDR.
perche: The SDK enhancements broaden on‑device AI options, making speech and language features easier to add without external servers.
